summary: Iteration 24 backend verification - both fixes confirmed working. CV NPS Adjustment upload now uses cv_adjustment.parse_feedback_report (correct 'Check Category' column for comments) and computes original_nps + nps_category server-side. New /api/qr/leaderboard-data merged endpoint and /api/qr/leaderboard/slide PNG sort by (conversion_rate, mentions, clicks) desc with 0-click rows pinned to bottom. Iteration 23 P0 regressions still green.

minor.issue: Non-xlsx/csv uploads return generic 500 instead of 400; the /server-performance/upload sibling guards extensions explicitly. Consider adding the same guard for parity / better UX.

action_items: (Optional) Add explicit .xlsx/.xls/.csv extension guard on /api/v2/cv/adjustment/upload so invalid files return HTTP 400 rather than 500.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/cv.py upload_cv_adjustment_file: confirmed it now delegates to cv_adjustment.parse_feedback_report (which handles NaN -> '' and uses 'Check Category' as the comment column) and calculate_nps for accurate counts. Field shape adapted to legacy frontend keys including nps_category, auto_detected, detection_reasons.

qr_tracking.get_leaderboard_with_mentions: sort key uses '-1 if total_clicks == 0 else conversion_rate' with reverse=True - correctly pins zero-click rows to the bottom. Within the non-zero block, tuple ordering on (conversion_rate, rt_mentions, total_clicks) matches the slide's tie-breakers.
Minor: routes/cv.py is ~1000 lines and has accumulated many endpoints; could be split per-feature when convenient (informational, not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Each upload test creates a cv_adjustment_sessions row and deletes it in a finally block via direct mongo cleanup (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME from /app/backend/.env).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_24.py is reusable. It depends on /tmp/feedback.xlsx (25 items, expected NPS 72.0, 21P/1P/3D) and /tmp/transaction.xlsx. If those files are removed, the CV upload tests will fail at the assert os.path.exists check. The P0 regression smoke probes are intentionally lightweight - the deeper coverage lives in test_save_snapshot_p0_fix.py (8 tests, all green this iteration).

verification_results.qr_leaderboard_data: returns {employees, count, quarter, year}; 0-click rows pinned to bottom; non-zero block sorted by (conversion_rate, rt_mentions, total_clicks) desc - validated programmatically
verification_results.iteration_23_p0_regressions: 8/8 passing (ghost not resurrected, nps_manual_override, raw POS edits persist, targeted delete with same-name dup, orphan PUT recovery, QR tripadvisor, CV adjustment upload q/y, current rankings active)
